question: Who among the following became a Member of the Legislative Assembly from Mokama, Bihar in India, in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neelam Devi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neelam Devi won the Mokama assembly seat in the Bihar elections held in November 2020.**

 
 
• She is a member of the **Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) party.**
 
 
 
• Tejashwi Yadav is also a member of the RJD party, but he did not contest from the Mokama constituency in the Bihar elections.
 
• Mohan Kumar Gupta and Anandiben Patel are not associated with the Bihar elections or the Mokama constituency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tejashwi Yadav is a prominent politician and the leader of the opposition in the ****Bihar Legislative Assembly.** 
 
• He is the son of former **Bihar Chief Minister Lalu Prasad Yadav**.
 
• Mohan Kumar Gupta and Anandiben Patel are not associated with the **Bihar elections or the Mokama constituency.**
 
• Mohan Kumar Gupta is a common name and there is **no information available on him being a politician**.
 
• Anandiben Patel is a former Chief Minister of Gujarat and currently serves as the Governor of Uttar Pradesh.
